entries.name: NitroValidator
entries.description: Validates AWS Nitro enclave attestations against the certificate chain verified by the CertManager.

entries.name: NamePortal
entries.description: Announces a zk.money name on Aztec. Anyone can send an L1->L2 message carrying a named account's name hash and bootstrap key to an Aztec address of their choice. It accepts only accounts deployed by ACCOUNT_FACTORY.

entries.name: SIPAFactory
entries.description: Deploys zk.money deposit addresses (SIPAs) as deterministic clones. A clone counts as blessed when its implementation was blessed and its ForwardingTable approved. Each clone's code and table are fixed in its address. New deposit addresses, from the wallet or the Resolver, clone the current implementation for their intent.

depositImplementation.description: Implementation cloned by new deposit addresses.

registrationImplementation.description: Implementation cloned by new name registration addresses.

userOpImplementation.description: Implementation cloned by new deposit addresses that run an ERC-4337 user operation.

blessedImplementations.description: Blessed implementations per intent (1 = Deposit, 2 = Registration, 3 = UserOp). Clones of any of them count as blessed.

approvedTables.description: ForwardingTables that blessed deposit addresses may use.

entries.name: OxideAccountFactory
entries.description: Permissionless factory for deterministic L1 accounts. The implementation is immutable and there is no administrator.

entries.name: ResolverVerifier
entries.description: UltraHonk verifier for the zk.money resolver circuit with a hardcoded verification key. The Resolver uses it to check that a resolver operator's answer matches the user's registered keys and L2 address.

verificationKeyHash.description: Circuit verification key hash embedded in the verified Solidity source.

$libraries.description: Runtime libraries immutably linked into this verifier.

entries.name: OxidePortal_sUSDS
entries.description: Escrow of zk.money on the Aztec Network. A withdrawal needs both a proven Aztec L2->L1 message from L2_TOKEN and a signature from a TEE signer registered in the TEE_REGISTRY. Once the Aztec Registry's canonical rollup is no longer ROLLUP, anyone can permanently freeze the portal, stopping deposits and fixing the refund snapshot at the last proven checkpoint. A refund needs a zk proof against that snapshot and a registered signer's signature.

L2_TOKEN.description: zk.money token contract on Aztec whose L2->L1 messages can release funds.

_$frozen.description: Whether the portal is permanently frozen. A frozen portal accepts no deposits. Withdrawals within the frozen checkpoint and epoch bounds remain available alongside refunds against the frozen state. L2 transfers are not disabled but do not change refundable ownership.

REGISTRY.description: Aztec Registry. If its canonical rollup is no longer ROLLUP, anyone can freeze this portal.

GLOBAL_LIMIT.description: Deposit capacity (wei), refilling at RATE per second. Withdrawals and refunds are only limited by TX_AMOUNT_CAP per transaction.

entries.name: ZKTranscriptLib
entries.description: Runtime library immutably linked into the zk.money resolver verifier. It evaluates circuit constraints or derives Fiat-Shamir challenges for zero-knowledge UltraHonk proofs.

entries.name: RegistrationController
entries.description: Completes paid name registrations from blessed registration addresses: deploys the user's L1 account, claims the name, writes the user record, optionally announces the name on Aztec through the NAME_PORTAL, and installs the user's first passkey. Fees above the relayer fee go to an allowlisted beneficiary.

ACCOUNT_FACTORY.description: Immutable factory and account implementation used to deploy users’ L1 passkey accounts.

beneficiaries.description: Allowlisted fee recipients. The NameRegistry owner can append entries, none can be removed.

entries.name: UserOpSIPA
entries.description: Implementation of zk.money deposit addresses that carry an operation of the user's L1 account. Sweeping a funded clone executes the account operation fixed in the clone's address through the ERC-4337 EntryPoint, with the user's signature, then pays the listed fees and deposits the rest into the portal its ForwardingTable names. The recipient's account can recover any funds from the clone.

entries.name: OperationExecutor
entries.description: Permissionless helper that executes a call and forwards the resulting token payout to the caller. Used by finalizers to collect fees and subsidies.

entries.name: MigrationExecutor
entries.description: Payout contract that moves refunds from the frozen SOURCE_PORTAL into DESTINATION_PORTAL. Only SOURCE_PORTAL can call it. It deposits the refund, minus the relayer tip committed in the refund, into DESTINATION_PORTAL for the recipient commitment the refund names.

SUBSIDY.description: Pays relayers of migrations from operator funds.

entries.name: PlainWithdrawalExecutor
entries.description: Default payout contract for withdrawals and refunds. Only the PORTAL can call it. It pays the recipient and relayer tip committed on Aztec. An ordinary withdrawal first pays FEE to BENEFICIARY, while refunds pay no fee.

FEE.description: Fee in ASSET (wei) taken from each ordinary withdrawal.

SUBSIDY.description: Pays relayers of this executor's payouts from operator funds.

entries.name: SkyEscrowFactory
entries.description: Deploys deterministic escrows for moving funds between the DAI and sUSDS portals. Anyone can execute a funded escrow. Its implementation and routes are immutable.

entries.name: FrozenNotesRefundVerifier
entries.description: UltraHonk verifier for refunds of notes that were unspent when the zk.money portal froze. Its verification key is immutable.

verificationKeyHash.description: Circuit verification key hash embedded in the verified Solidity source.

entries.name: TeeRegistry
entries.description: Registry of the TEE signers that the zk.money portals accept for withdrawals and refunds. Anyone can register a signer with an AWS Nitro attestation of the enclave image PCR0_HASH that is at most TEE_ATTESTATION_MAX_AGE seconds old. Registration also sends an L1->L2 message to L2_RECIPIENT, whose inclusion the zk.money contracts on Aztec prove to accept the signer there. Registrations are permanent, and the approved image cannot change.

PCR0_HASH.description: keccak256 of the PCR0 measurement of the only AWS Nitro enclave image whose attestations can register signers.

L2_RECIPIENT.description: Aztec address that signer registration messages are sent to.

teeSigners.description: Registered TEE signers. Registrations are permanent.

entries.name: SwapEscrowFactory
entries.description: Swap-on-withdraw: a withdrawal can pay DAI to a SwapEscrowV2 clone whose route, recipient, gas share and tip are fixed in its address. Anyone can deploy and execute a funded clone to pay USDC, USDT, ETH or DAI to the recipient.

entries.name: MigrationExecutor_sUSDS
entries.description: Payout contract that moves refunds from the frozen SOURCE_PORTAL into DESTINATION_PORTAL. Only SOURCE_PORTAL can call it. It deposits the refund, minus the relayer tip committed in the refund, into DESTINATION_PORTAL for the recipient commitment the refund names.

SUBSIDY.description: Pays relayers of migrations from operator funds.

entries.name: RegistrationSIPA
entries.description: Implementation of zk.money registration addresses. Sweeping a funded clone registers the name through the current RegistrationController of the NameRegistry, pays the committed and listed fees and deposits the rest into the portal its ForwardingTable names. The recipient's account can recover any funds from the clone.

entries.name: FrozenDepositsRefundVerifier
entries.description: UltraHonk verifier for refunds of deposits that reached Aztec but were unspent when the zk.money portal froze. Its verification key is immutable.

verificationKeyHash.description: Circuit verification key hash embedded in the verified Solidity source.

entries.name: NameRegistry
entries.description: Registry of zk.money names. It points to the RegistrationController and the AccountMetadataRegistry, which together decide where payments to a zk.money name resolve to.

entries.name: SkyEscrow
entries.description: Implementation for savings conversion escrows. Each clone fixes the route, deposit commitment, relayer tip and recovery commitment in its address. It converts DAI into sUSDS or redeposits DAI after a savings withdrawal. The recovery account can reclaim stranded tokens, including shares taken without redemption.

entries.name: DepositSIPA
entries.description: Implementation of zk.money deposit addresses. Anyone can sweep a funded clone, which swaps USDC or USDT to DAI, pays the fees its ForwardingTable lists and deposits the rest into the portal that table names for the token, for the recipient fixed in the clone's address. The recipient's account can recover any funds from the clone.

entries.name: Resolver
entries.description: ENS resolver for zk.money names. It returns a deposit address derived from a resolver operator's answer, which must come with a zk proof that it matches the user's registered keys and L2 address in the AccountMetadataRegistry.

ensNode.description: ENS node monitored for this deployment.

ensNodeOwner.description: Owner of zk.money in the ENS registry. The DNS domain holder can reclaim this DNS name in ENS with a DNSSEC proof.

ensResolver.description: Resolver set for zk.money in the ENS registry.

entries.name: SwapEscrow
entries.description: SwapEscrowV2 implementation. A clone swaps via the Curve 3pool (and Uniswap for ETH) with a slippage bound of 100 bps for stablecoins and 200 bps against the Chainlink ETH/USD price for ETH. It can first swap a capped share of the DAI to ETH for the recipient's gas. If the swap cannot execute, only the recovery key committed in the clone's address can move the funds.

entries.name: OxidePortal
entries.description: Escrow of zk.money on the Aztec Network. A withdrawal needs both a proven Aztec L2->L1 message from L2_TOKEN and a signature from a TEE signer registered in the TEE_REGISTRY. Once the Aztec Registry's canonical rollup is no longer ROLLUP, anyone can permanently freeze the portal, stopping deposits and fixing the refund snapshot at the last proven checkpoint. A refund needs a zk proof against that snapshot and a registered signer's signature.

L2_TOKEN.description: zk.money token contract on Aztec whose L2->L1 messages can release funds.

_$frozen.description: Whether the portal is permanently frozen. A frozen portal accepts no deposits. Withdrawals within the frozen checkpoint and epoch bounds remain available alongside refunds against the frozen state. L2 transfers are not disabled but do not change refundable ownership.

REGISTRY.description: Aztec Registry. If its canonical rollup is no longer ROLLUP, anyone can freeze this portal.

GLOBAL_LIMIT.description: Deposit capacity (wei), refilling at RATE per second. Withdrawals and refunds are only limited by TX_AMOUNT_CAP per transaction.

entries.name: PortalFactory
entries.description: Deploys OxidePortals that share its TEE_REGISTRY and refund verifiers. Each portal is a separate escrow for one token and one L2 token contract, and nothing in a deployed portal refers back to the factory.

entries.name: RelationsLib
entries.description: Runtime library immutably linked into the zk.money resolver verifier. It evaluates circuit constraints or derives Fiat-Shamir challenges for zero-knowledge UltraHonk proofs.

entries.name: PlainWithdrawalExecutor_sUSDS
entries.description: Default payout contract for withdrawals and refunds. Only the PORTAL can call it. It pays the recipient and relayer tip committed on Aztec. An ordinary withdrawal first pays FEE to BENEFICIARY, while refunds pay no fee.

FEE.description: Fee in ASSET (wei) taken from each ordinary withdrawal.

SUBSIDY.description: Pays relayers of this executor's payouts from operator funds.

entries.name: OxideAccount
entries.description: Immutable implementation of users' L1 accounts. The bootstrap key authorizes the first passkey. Once a passkey is installed, only the user's passkeys can authorize operations and manage keys. The last passkey cannot be removed. Deposit recovery checks signatures against this account.

entries.name: AccountMetadataRegistry
entries.description: Stores user records (Aztec L2 address, keys, chosen resolver operator) and resolver operator entries. User records can be written by the user or by the RegistrationController. Anyone can register as a resolver operator.

resolverOperators.description: Registered resolver operators with their latest entry (public key, L2 address, gateway URL, portal).

entries.name: CertManager
entries.description: Verifies and caches AWS Nitro attestation certificates. The only trust anchor is the hardcoded AWS Nitro root certificate.

entries.name: UnprocessedDepositRefundVerifier
entries.description: UltraHonk verifier for refunds of deposits that never reached Aztec before the zk.money portal froze. Its verification key is immutable.

verificationKeyHash.description: Circuit verification key hash embedded in the verified Solidity source.

entries.name: SkyWithdrawalExecutor
entries.description: Payout contract for sUSDS withdrawals and refunds. Only the PORTAL can execute a payout. It normally redeems sUSDS into USDS and converts USDS to DAI before paying the committed recipient and relayer tip. The recipient can complete an ordinary withdrawal in sUSDS shares through withdrawInShares, bypassing redemption.

entries.name: ForwardingTable
entries.description: Routing table of zk.money deposit addresses. For each listed token it names the portal that deposit addresses using this table sweep into, and per intent the fee for the beneficiary and the tip for the sweeper. Rows and intents can only be added, never changed or removed.

_$beneficiary.description: Receives the beneficiary fee of each sweep through this table.

rows.description: Listed tokens with the portal their deposits sweep into and the fees per intent (1 = Deposit, 2 = Registration, 3 = UserOp).

addedIntents.description: Fees per intent added to listed tokens after their row.
